# Game Catalog

A selected Unbound Cloud game defines which species, moves, items, and balls exist and supplies most names and species data. CFRU supplies compiled move details and item kinds; DPE supplies learnsets, battle forms, and local sprites. The catalog carries diagnostics and image URLs rather than writing to any reference repository.

## Files

- [source-inventory.js](../../../server/services/source-inventory.js) consumes exported reader constants from repositories, catalog, learnsets, sprites, and assets to define portable ZIP sources. `validateCatalogData` checks available-game/shared JSON offline before accepting an imported archive.
- [repositories.js](../../../server/services/repositories.js): `readCloudGames` discovers Cloud's declared games and form icon names from `src/PokemonUtil.jsx`, filters games without required files, and orders official games first, then by display name.
- [workspaces.js](../../../server/endpoints/workspaces.js): `POST /api/workspaces/load` supplies the game menu; `POST /api/workspaces/:id/catalog` calls `loadGameCatalog` for a selected `gameId`.
- [catalog.js](../../../server/services/catalog.js): `createCatalogService`, `loadGameCatalog`, `readGameData`; joins Cloud JSON, CFRU tables, DPE data, sprites, and unresolved-symbol warnings into one per-game response.
- [data-parser.js](../../../server/services/data-parser.js): `parseBattleMoves`, `parseItemTypes`, `parseLevelUpLearnsets`, `parseEggMoves`, `parseTeachableTables`, `parseCompatibilityFile`, `parseEvolutionTable`, `parseSpriteTable` read active C data and compatibility text without evaluating C expressions.
- [learnsets.js](../../../server/services/learnsets.js): `parseDpeSources`, `loadDpeData`, `buildLearnsets`, `buildBattleForms` load DPE move sources, inherit moves, and identify Mega Evolution/Gigantamax forms.
- [sprites.js](../../../server/services/sprites.js): `parseSpriteSources`, `loadSpriteTables`, `getDpeSpriteUrls`, `renderSprite`, `combineSpritePalette` map DPE species to graphics and render normal/shiny indexed PNGs.
- [assets.js](../../../server/services/assets.js): `readCloudImages`, `resolveCloudImage`, `getSpeciesIcon`, `getSpeciesSprites`, `getItemIcon`, `getBallIcon`, `getTypeIcon`, `getTypeSymbol`, `getGigantamaxIcon` select available local and remote artwork.
- [pokeapi.js](../../../server/services/pokeapi.js): `createPokeApiIndex` caches PokeAPI Pokemon and type name-to-ID lists for form-accurate sprite URLs.
- [type-images.js](../../../server/services/type-images.js): `createTypeImageCache` and `getTypeImageCache` persist both type artwork formats under the editor data folder and share the cache between catalog loading and image routes.
- [images.js](../../../server/endpoints/images.js): token-free, workspace-scoped Cloud PNG and DPE sprite routes with same-site resource policy and image cache headers.
- [parse-cache.js](../../../server/services/parse-cache.js): `createParseCache`, `getParserVersion`, `hash`, `hashMacros` invalidate parsed CFRU/DPE data when sources, macros, or parser implementation change.
- [catalog.mjs](../../../shared/catalog.mjs): `LEARN_SOURCES`, `LEARNSET_COMPLETE`, `LEGALITY`, `getMoveLegality`, `POWER_KIND`, `getPowerKind`, `alwaysHits`, `getMegaEvolutions`, `getOutOfBattleForm`, and `isBattleOnlySpecies` are pure shared interpretations.
- [showdown.mjs](../../../shared/showdown.mjs): `resolveImportedSet` consumes base-form mappings and selected-game names/legality. [SpreadDialogs.jsx](../../../src/components/SpreadDialogs.jsx): Add Spread excludes battle-only choices and imports pasted Showdown text through the shared adapter; see [Showdown Exchange](../showdown-exchange/SKILL.md).
- [CatalogDisplay.jsx](../../../src/subcomponents/CatalogDisplay.jsx): `getLabel`, `getEntry`, `getSpeciesFormName`, `TypeIcon`, `SplitIcon`, `GameImage`, `OverflowText`, `getSearchRank`, `filterBySearch`, `useIncrementalList`, and `scrollToEntry` display and search catalog data.
- [Theme.jsx](../../../src/Theme.jsx): `createRankedFilterOptions` supplies the site-wide Autocomplete default: prefix matches before other substring matches, preserving order within each group and MUI's case/accent normalization. The saved-export picker uses the same factory with its label/date searchable text; catalog pickers retain `filterBySearch`.
- [Header.jsx](../../../src/components/Header.jsx): `Load Warnings` groups source diagnostics into expandable lists. [SpreadEditorState.jsx](../../../src/SpreadEditorState.jsx): game selection, catalog loading, and changed-move existence checks before save.

## Data flow

1. Workspace load parses Cloud's game configuration as source, rather than executing it. It keeps declared games with the required `baseStats`, `moves`, `items`, and `ballTypes` JSON files, returns menu IDs/names, and warns about unavailable games. The browser restores a saved game only when still listed; selecting a game posts its ID to the catalog route.
2. `loadGameCatalog` rejects unknown game IDs with `GAME_NOT_FOUND`, parses every required game JSON object, and reads optional shared Cloud name, dex, move, type, ability, shiny, and image data. Missing shared files use empty maps with warnings; malformed JSON or non-object required data yields `CATALOG_INVALID`.
3. In parallel it loads CFRU's preprocessed `gBattleMoves`, DPE's move/evolution tables, the PokeAPI index, Cloud image listings, and DPE sprite tables. CFRU `gItemsByType` is parsed separately using the same compiled config macros; missing item tables leave `itemType: null` and a warning.
4. The service builds species and moves first, then items, balls, types, and game-specific learnsets and battle forms. It counts complete learnsets, counts unresolved constants used by loaded spreads, attaches all diagnostics, and returns `gameId`, `name`, `entryCounts`, `species`, `learnsets`, `moves`, `items`, `balls`, `abilities`, `natures`, `types`, `assets`, `unresolved`, and `diagnostics`.
5. Catalog loading downloads both type artwork formats into `<data root>/cache/type-images/{symbol,full}/` before returning local URLs. Browser helpers render names and icons, choose move legality and power displays, and show `Load Warnings`. Local image URLs go through `/api/images/:workspaceId/...`; remaining remote URLs go directly to PokeAPI/PokeSprite and are resolved by `GameImage` at display time.

## Behavior and user decisions

- Cloud's game menu comes from `GAME_DISPLAY_NAMES` and `GAME_IDS_TO_DATA` in `PokemonUtil.jsx`. Only declared games with resolvable existing required files are selectable. The `cfru` official game precedes the remaining games sorted by name. `SPECIES_FORMS_ICON_NAMES` supplies icon aliases. A missing saved choice sends the browser to `Choose Game` rather than silently selecting another game.
- Available Cloud `BaseStats.json` species exclude `SPECIES_NONE`. Each entry has `name`, `showdownName` from alternate names when available, `dex`, numeric `dexNumber`, base stats (`hp`, `atk`, `def`, `spAtk`, `spDef`, `spd`), two types, three abilities ordered hidden/slot 1/slot 2, icon, normal/shiny sprite info, `megas`, and `gigantamax`. Stats require integers in the supported range; types and abilities are checked mainly for JavaScript string type, not constant syntax or catalog membership. Invalid stats and non-string types/abilities stay `null` and generate `CATALOG_SPECIES_INCOMPLETE` with every affected species in `details`. `ABILITY_NONE` intentionally becomes null without itself triggering that warning. Missing shared names fall back to readable constants.
- Available Cloud moves exclude `MOVE_NONE`; Cloud supplies names and fallback type/split/PP, while compiled CFRU `gBattleMoves` supplies power, `zMovePower`, `maxMovePower`, accuracy, priority, target, effect, secondary chance, flags, and preferred type/split/PP. An absent CFRU move has `local: false` with unknown details and `MOVE_DETAILS_MISSING`. CFRU/Cloud differences in type, split, or PP use CFRU and yield `MOVE_DATA_MISMATCH` with every difference in `details`.
- `parseBattleMoves` reads literal numeric/symbol/flag fields from the active branch; unreadable values generally remain `null`. `z_move_power` maps to `zMovePower`; `gDynamaxMovePowers` supplies `maxMovePower`, which is `null` if that table is not compiled. When the table exists, missing moves and unreadable explicit values become zero through `?? 0`. `getPowerKind` returns unknown for null, none for zero, variable for one, otherwise fixed; `alwaysHits` means CFRU accuracy zero.
- Items use Cloud names and either PokeSprite's Cloud `link` or an existing local Cloud image; `ITEM_NONE` has no icon. `itemType` comes from CFRU `gItemsByType`, with unknown kinds left null. Balls use Cloud names and PokeSprite ball images; `BALL_TYPE_RANDOM` is always named `Random` with no icon. Natures and abilities use Cloud shared name maps. Types have a `symbol` PokeSprite icon and a full `icon` banner from PokeAPI when indexed, otherwise PokeSprite. `assets.gigantamax` is a Cloud image when present.
- `loadDpeData` uses DPE config and active `Learnsets.c`, `Egg_Moves.c`, `TM_Tutor_Tables.c`, `Evolution Table.c`, and numbered TM/tutor compatibility files. Level zero is an evolution move; compatibility file number selects the table move even when the heading disagrees. Missing or uncompiled level-up tables leave status `missing` and legality unknown, even if other sources supply moves. Available source labels have fixed `LEARN_SOURCE_ORDER`.
- `buildLearnsets` combines level, egg, TM, tutor, special breeding/tutor, pre-evolution, shared-form, form-change, and Sketch sources. Permanent evolution and selected form links inherit until no new moves appear; Mega and Gigantamax evolutions do not inherit as permanent forms. Sketch adds game moves except Struggle, Chatter, and Sketch itself. CFRU's `EXPANDED_MOVE_TUTORS` and conditional `UNBOUND` macros decide special tutor availability; otherwise applicable moves can be marked `unknown` with a reason. Form-specific replacement moves are added after inheritance. Eternatus Eternamax uses base Eternatus's final learnset, including completeness, all move sources and conditional unknown reasons. `LEARNSET_MISSING` lists all affected game species when a level-up table exists.
- Cosplay Pikachu signatures are added by `COSPLAY_FORM_CHANGE_MOVES` after inheritance with source `formChange`, so ordinary Pikachu and other costumes do not inherit them: Libre gets `MOVE_FLYINGPRESS`, Rock Star `MOVE_METEORMASH`, Belle `MOVE_ICICLECRASH`, and Pop Star `MOVE_DRAININGKISS`. DPE assigns these forms the ordinary Pikachu level-up table; CFRU's `gPikachuSpreads` confirms these four signatures. Pop Star additionally gets `MOVE_FLEURCANNON` (the user's confirmed Unbound grant) and PhD gets `MOVE_FLAMETHROWER` only when the evaluated CFRU config defines `UNBOUND`, not from a Cloud game name. Pop Star retains Draining Kiss and its inherited moves. This small fallback table covers grants not represented by DPE learnsets; the checkout has no dedicated cosplay teaching routine. Only moves available in the selected game are added, and missing DPE learnsets still mean unknown legality. Shared `getMoveLegality`, both move pickers, and Auto-Fix consume the resulting learnsets without separate species exceptions. Changes to this table invalidate parsed caches through the existing hash of the learnsets module; no cache format bump is needed.
- `SHARED_FORM_PREFIXES` includes `SPECIES_MINIOR`: `SPECIES_MINIOR_SHIELD` and the red, blue, orange, yellow, indigo, green and violet cores share moves bidirectionally. The user's DPE lists the seven correctly spelled `MINIOR_*` cores, not Shield, in compatibility files and maps all eight constants to `sMiniorShieldLevelUpLearnset`. No spelling aliases are needed. Real-layout fixtures cover TM 10 Hidden Power, 26 Earthquake, 29 Psychic, 80 Rock Slide and tutors 20 Gravity, 23 Magnet Rise and 132 Meteor Beam, parsed from numbered files through the full catalog. Move sharing preserves each form's own completeness check; an absent level-up entry remains `missing`. A read-only check of the user's four CFRU Minior spreads found all 15 distinct moves allowed by the current code; an API process started before these fixes still needs a manual restart, since Node's required modules and parser-version hash remain in memory.
- `buildBattleForms` reads DPE `EVO_MEGA` entries triggered by held `ITEM_*` or `MOVE_*`, including the variant, and enabled `EVO_GIGANTAMAX` entries. Each form records whether its target species is in the selected game; missing targets yield `BATTLE_FORM_UNAVAILABLE`. `getMegaEvolutions` returns only a species' item- or move-triggered matches, not every possible form.
- `getOutOfBattleForm(catalog, species)` returns `{ species, item, gigantamax }` for a recognized battle-only form, otherwise null; `isBattleOnlySpecies` tests that result. Its map first includes the fixed Cloud-style battle-only list when both form and base exist, then DPE-derived `megas` and `gigantamax` links, then missing-link constant suffix fallbacks for `_MEGA` (including X/Y/Z), `_PRIMAL`, and `_GIGA` when the base exists. DPE links take precedence over the fixed list; suffix fallbacks do not override established mappings. Only DPE Mega metadata supplies a held item; fixed-list/suffix mappings use null. Move-triggered Mega mappings identify the base without carrying or adding a triggering move. The map is cached in a WeakMap keyed by catalog object, so do not mutate its species/form metadata after a lookup; replace the catalog object when it changes.
- Add Spread's Choose Species list excludes `isBattleOnlySpecies` entries and ignores battle-only default selections, except Eternatus Eternamax and Zygarde Complete are selectable for sets with category `raidRush` only. Switching to another destination hides their preview and disables Add until a valid species is selected. The catalog retains battle-only forms for sprites, Mega Stats, and name resolution. Showdown import/overwrite first prefer exact `showdownName` matches, then out-of-battle candidates when names overlap; an exclusively battle-only match becomes its base species with a compact warning, an inferred item when omitted and known, and a Gigantamax flag when applicable. Explicit conflicting items remain with a warning; unavailable abilities fall back to the base default rather than blocking import. This is not a blanket rewrite or save-time ban on battle-only species already present in source.
- `SHARED_FORM_FAMILIES` includes Zygarde's 50%, 10% and Complete forms, sharing level-up, egg, TM and tutor moves bidirectionally through the existing form inheritance edges. Each form retains its own level-up completeness check; missing data still means unknown legality. Special tutors continue to use each species' types/dex and active CFRU macros. Mega Zygarde is not part of this standard-form family.
- `getMoveLegality` returns `none` for 0/`MOVE_NONE`, `undefined` if the selected game lacks the move, `unknown` without a complete species learnset or when `learnset.unknown` gives a conditional reason, `allowed` with learn sources when present, and `illegal` otherwise. Browser save validation blocks newly selected undefined moves, not every move marked illegal or unknown.
- `loadSpriteTables` matches DPE front tiles, normal palette, and shiny back palette through its tables and graphics listings, including `graphics/frontspr/palette_only` and `graphics/backspr/palette_only`. Keep these folders in exported `GRAPHICS_FOLDERS`, which source inventory consumes for archive export/import. A missing per-species shiny mapping still permits a normal local sprite and uses other shiny artwork; an absent or unparseable whole shiny table disables the entire DPE sprite result. Catalog `getSprites` gives DPE full sprites priority with other artwork as fallbacks, without a Cloud gen-9 override. `combineSpritePalette` uses indexed PNG IHDR and IDAT from front tiles, swaps in normal or shiny PLTE, emits `tRNS` making palette index zero transparent, and writes PNG chunk CRCs. Outside DPE, selection is Cloud custom image, exact PokeAPI form, Cloud gen-9 image, PokeSprite form icon with base PokeAPI fallback, or null. Custom Unbound shiny colors apply only to game IDs matching `unbound` or `unbound_*`.
- Squawkabilly uses Cloud's actual constants: `SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY` is green; the other forms end in `_BLUE`, `_YELLOW`, and `_WHITE`. Cloud has all four `SPECIES_*.png` files in `public/images/gen_9` and `gen_9/shiny`; these 68x56 images contain compact 20x20 artwork, not full sprites. `getSpeciesIcon(species, iconName, images)` keeps the normal local image for compact icons online and offline. DPE points all four forms at the shared 64x64 `gFrontSprite1287SquawkabillyTiles`, with distinct normal/shiny palette PNGs: green in the top-level graphics folders and blue/yellow/white in their `palette_only` subfolders. Resolve those palettes and retain DPE precedence. When DPE is absent, exact PokeAPI full sprites precede gen-9 compact fallback images: `POKEAPI_NAMES` maps `squawkabilly-{green,blue,yellow,white}-plumage` to 931, 10260, 10261, 10262 (96x96 PNGs). Without a PokeAPI index, green still resolves by its exact dex name/number; other forms can fall back to Cloud when present. Without local compact images, icons separately fall back to `SQUAWKABILLY_ICON_NAMES` at `https://img.pokemondb.net/sprites/scarlet-violet/icon/squawkabilly-{color}.png`. Cloud supplies no form icon aliases and PokeSprite's gen-8 Squawkabilly icons return 404; do not use remote full sprites as compact icons.
- Cloud image links are emitted only for filenames found in allowlisted image folders: `root`, `items`, `gen9`, `gen9Shiny`, `unboundShinies`. `resolveCloudImage` accepts only a simple `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+.png` in one folder and rejects traversal or unknown folders; owned-file resolution forbids links outside Cloud. The sprite endpoint accepts only `normal`/`shiny` and a `SPECIES_[A-Z0-9_]+.png` found in loaded DPE tables, and reads only owned DPE files. Both routes send PNGs with private one-hour caching, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-site`, and `nosniff`. Images cannot send a session token, so the image routes rely on these restrictions and local-host security.
- PokeAPI index is downloaded as name-to-ID lists, cached outside repositories for 30 days, deduplicated across concurrent loads, and refresh failures keep an older index. Without one, sprites may use dex numbers or icons and emit `SPRITES_OFFLINE`; lack of PokeAPI never blocks catalog loading. Parsed CFRU moves/item types use source hash plus macros and parser version; DPE tables/sprite tables hash their sources and parser version. Rendered DPE PNGs are cached per workspace/table version with a bounded map.
- Type symbols and full banners are cached separately by lowercase type name, shared across games/workspaces, and reused without network requests after restarts even when the PokeAPI index is unavailable. Downloads are deduplicated, timeout after five seconds, reject non-PNG/oversized responses, and write atomically outside repositories. Failures retain remote fallbacks and retry no more than once per five minutes in that cache instance. `/api/images/:workspaceId/types/:variant/:file` checks the workspace, permits only `symbol`/`full` PNG cache entries, never fetches on requests, and uses the existing image security/cache headers. Initial offline loads cannot populate missing artwork.
- Every aggregated diagnostic with a `details` list retains all affected entries, even though its message shows only a few examples. Not every single-file diagnostic has `details`; do not truncate an existing list when changing diagnostics. `UNRESOLVED_SYMBOL` records every unknown species, move, item, ball, or nature constant with spread counts and does not guess replacements. The `Load Warnings` dialog groups by repository, source file when `details` exist, and diagnostic code; expanded groups show every detail as a list item or the message when there are no details. Its heading count is the number of lines, not the number of diagnostic objects.
- `getLabel` returns the string or object's `name`, falling back to the constant; `getEntry` returns null for absent/non-string keys. `getSpeciesFormName` adds the alternate showdown suffix only when it starts with the plain species name plus `-`. `TypeIcon` defaults to the symbol only, with `full` selecting the banner; `SplitIcon` uses the physical/special/status icon and tooltip. `GameImage` keeps explicit dimensions, resolves server URLs, tries successive sources on error, and shows a placeholder if none load. `OverflowText` opens a tooltip only when text actually overflows. Search trims and ignores case, ranks prefix matches before substring matches while keeping order within each rank. `useIncrementalList` starts at 100, loads 100 more near the scroll bottom, and resets on `resetKey` changes.

## Invariants and pitfalls

- Catalog availability is per selected game. Do not substitute a similarly named Cloud constant, use a different game's stats, or treat unknown DPE legality as proven illegal.
- Keep battle-only entries in the catalog. Share `getOutOfBattleForm` between Add/import rather than duplicating filters or form tables, respect selected-game base availability for fixed/suffix fallbacks, and preserve catalog-object replacement for WeakMap invalidation.
- Do not make PokeAPI or optional Cloud image failures fatal. Keep sprite fallbacks and null details honest; CFRU values take precedence over disagreeing Cloud move details.
- Parse only compiler-active C branches and invalidate cache entries when configuration macros, sources, or parser code change. Keep [catalog.mjs](../../../shared/catalog.mjs) free of browser and Node APIs.
- Keep image routing constrained to the selected workspace and allowlisted owned files. Preserve complete diagnostic detail arrays for warning grouping.

- [Showdown.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/Showdown.test.jsx), [ShowdownDialogs.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/ShowdownDialogs.test.jsx), and [AddReorder.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/AddReorder.test.jsx): battle-only helper mappings, exact alternate-name/base preference, Mega/Gigantamax import, ability fallback, and excluded Add choices/defaults. From root run `yarn test src/tests/Showdown.test.jsx --run`, `yarn test src/tests/ShowdownDialogs.test.jsx --run`, and `yarn test src/tests/AddReorder.test.jsx --run`. [showdown.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/showdown.test.js) covers Mega/base ability resolution and terse warnings: from server run `yarn test tests/services/showdown.test.js`.
- [catalog.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/catalog.test.js): compiled move/item/DPE tables, learnset inheritance, conditional legality, battle forms, artwork selection, indexed shiny PNGs, PokeAPI cache/offline behavior, and shared lookups. Focused regressions cover Pop Star's active-`UNBOUND` Fleur Cannon grant, real-layout Minior Shield/core TM/tutor sharing and completeness, DPE Squawkabilly full sprites with shared tiles and nested form-specific normal/shiny palettes, rendered 64x64 PNGs, source inventory inclusion, exact PokeAPI precedence over compact Cloud artwork, separate compact icons, missing normal/shiny palette fallbacks, and offline catalog assembly. `createMiniorDpeFiles` and `createSquawkabillyArtworkFiles` in the catalog fixture helper reproduce the user's reference layouts synthetically. Catalog assembly and Cloud image discovery use disposable repositories with fixture-local `SPREAD_EDITOR_DATA_DIR`, restore the environment, and clean up even on failure; assembly also verifies macro-sensitive cache reloads. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/services/catalog.test.js`.
- [workspaces.test.js](../../../server/tests/endpoints/workspaces.test.js): Cloud game list/order, per-game payload/diagnostics, fallback/offline cases, image route allowlist and PNGs, catalog cache, invalid games and JSON. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/endpoints/workspaces.test.js`.
- Type-cache regressions in [catalog.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/catalog.test.js) cover both formats, persistence without an index, deduplication, invalid/offline downloads and cache path restrictions. Endpoint regressions verify both PNGs after an offline restart, no downloads on cached loads, and image headers/route restrictions. Existing TypeIcon assertions in [MovePicker.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/MovePicker.test.jsx) verify local symbol versus banner URLs.
- [parse-cache.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/parse-cache.test.js): per-input cache invalidation and unreadable-cache fallback. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/services/parse-cache.test.js`.
- [RepositorySetup.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/RepositorySetup.test.jsx): game selection and `Load Warnings` grouping/detail expansion. Run: `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/RepositorySetup.test.jsx --run`.
- [MovePicker.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/MovePicker.test.jsx), [ItemPicker.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/ItemPicker.test.jsx), and [SpreadEditor.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadEditor.test.jsx): legality, picker names/icons/search/pagination, type symbol versus full banner, and selected-game presentation. Run: `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/MovePicker.test.jsx --run`, `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/ItemPicker.test.jsx --run`, and `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/SpreadEditor.test.jsx --run`.
- [catalog-fixtures.js](../../../server/tests/helpers/catalog-fixtures.js) and [fixture-repositories.js](../../../server/tests/helpers/fixture-repositories.js) build synthetic data and disposable repositories; [EditorFixtures.js](../../../src/tests/EditorFixtures.js) supplies browser catalogs. Set `SPREAD_EDITOR_DATA_DIR` to a temporary fixture data folder for server tests and use temporary repository copies. Never write real CFRU, DPE, or Unbound Cloud checkouts.

## Change checklist

1. Trace the game's Cloud file mapping, CFRU compiled values, DPE sources/macros, and image fallbacks before changing catalog fields or legality. For battle forms, also trace shared mappings, catalog-object caching, Add choices, and Showdown resolution. Keep unknown values and complete diagnostic lists accurate.
2. Update targeted server fixture and endpoint assertions plus browser-visible tests for names, warnings, icons, legality, search, or loading states as appropriate. Check offline and missing-source cases.
3. Verify image URL allowlists, canonical owned-file checks, parser/cache invalidation, PNG normal/shiny rendering, and mobile-compatible fixed icon dimensions when those paths change.
4. Run the narrowest relevant commands above. Update this skill when its behavior or file ownership changes. After server code changes, remind the user to restart the API server on port 3001.
